description: This file defines the CommandInfo class which encapsulates information about a console command, including its command string and associated ArrayInput. It is part of a scheduling component within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CommandInfo
classes.description: A class that holds information about a specific console command and its input parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CommandInfo object with a command string and optional ArrayInput object.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command string associated with this CommandInfo.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the ArrayInput object associated with this CommandInfo, or null if none was provided.
